head: 96d39ed
RULE: Law 1 -- recall beats report-tidiness. Everything here was set aside by the deduplicator and is VISIBLE, not deleted. Nothing in this file has been culled; culling happens at triage (/ledger), never by withholding a finding from the run a human reviews.

manualReview.title: autoAnnihilate's approve-then-pull leg at :600 is the only token movement in the new code that is NOT balance-measured
manualReview.reason: PARKED, NOT DROPPED. Almost certainly C4-invalid: generic fee-on-transfer is known-invalid on this project unless in scope, and the token set is an owner-curated stablecoin allowlist (addToken:252) that must ALSO be registered on the phUSD stable minter. Parked rather than removed for ONE reason the source itself gives: the harm would land on the FOREIGN Antimatter/phUSD contract's BACKING, not on StableStaker, so this contract's own conservation checks (ECON-005, INV-1/INV-2) are structurally incapable of detecting it. A negative result on our side is not a negative result on theirs.
manualReview.whatWouldEscalate: Any pool token admitted to addToken that charges a transfer fee, or any change that lets a non-allowlisted token reach :600.

manualReview.title: NEGATIVE RESULT (kept as evidence): emission conservation holds EXACTLY at every decimals boundary
manualReview.reason: Not a finding. Parked as SUPPORTING EVIDENCE because it is the load-bearing rebuttal to the over-mint half of PATTERN-002/DEDUP-001 and to F-05's raw-mint framing. Any report that describes the gate bypass MUST carry this alongside it, or it will overstate. Boundaries proven: zeroStake, dustStake, wholePosition, eighteenDecimals. Corroborated by INV-1 PASS (640,640 Foundry calls + 302,817 Medusa calls) and INV-2 PASS (max observed overshoot = 0 in BOTH campaigns, so the 1024-wei DUST_SLACK was never consumed).

manualReview.title: NEGATIVE RESULT (kept as evidence): the surplus leg at :609 is NOT exploitable
manualReview.reason: Not a finding. Parked as evidence supporting DEDUP-006's 'caller is value-neutral' claim. Five paths enumerated and each closed: direct ERC4626 (received <= gross strictly, surplus structurally 0); market strategy (self-sandwich unprofitable); donation to the vault (symmetric, donor loses); donation of token to StableStaker (_routeExit measures a delta, balanceBefore absorbs it); underwater buffer branch (received == gross by construction, caller exactly neutral).

manualReview.title: NEGATIVE RESULT (kept as evidence): the linear pro-ration error is O(1) ABSOLUTE, not a rate drift, and is not amplifiable
manualReview.reason: Not a finding. Parked as the rebuttal that keeps MR-17-01 from being mis-filed as the project's Linear-Depletion family bug. Key sentence to carry: 'because the error is ABSOLUTE rather than proportional, a caller choosing gross cannot scale it -- the same 2-unit flat allowance that absorbs it at 1 USDC absorbs it at 1,000,000 USDC.' In the WIRED configuration the pro-ration never engages at all (grossQuote == gross, netFloor == netQuote exactly).

manualReview.title: NEGATIVE RESULT: the netWanted=1 availability probe is NOT a free option in value terms
manualReview.reason: Parked. A deeply-capped real quote diverts value into the raw-AM path at :605, but total Antimatter is CONSERVED: the caller receives the same `owed` either way, only the delivery FORM changes (annihilated now vs. raw AM they must later pair with their own stablecoin at the same 1:1 rate). No extra AM => no free option. The half of ECON-007 that DOES survive (view honesty) was FILED as DEDUP-010; only this negative half is parked.

manualReview.title: withdraw:424 and autoAnnihilate:609 both forward the FULL measured `received` while debiting only the requested amount, so an over-delivering strategy pays protocol-owned yield to the caller
manualReview.reason: PARKED, NOT DROPPED. This CONTRADICTS _routeExit's own NatSpec ('sub-amount differences remain protocol-owned yield/loss'), so it is a live doc-vs-code mismatch. Parked because the behaviour is PRE-EXISTING in withdraw and therefore outside this regression run's diff range, and because ECON-006 established it is not exploitable on any wired path. It should be re-examined on the next COLD (--full) run, where it is in range.
manualReview.crossRepo: reflax-yield-vault L-23 / e6088a0ec5 ('one-directional protocol-favouring write-down: the market strategy pays out over-delivery from the commingled position') is the other side of this. See DEDUP-007.ALSO_ARMS.

manualReview.title: A SECOND dust revert, distinct from DEDUP-003: owed < scale with non-zero principal reverts 'nothing to annihilate' at :546
manualReview.reason: PARKED SEPARATELY so it is not silently absorbed into DEDUP-003. Different predicate (:546 require(netWanted > 0 || excessBase > 0) vs. :588 require(received > 0)), different message, different cause (sub-unit reward vs. convertToShares round-down). Reward below one raw token unit is temporarily UNREACHABLE (claim is also gated) but it ACCRUES rather than being stranded, and the :548 write is rolled back. Genuinely dust-level. If DEDUP-003 gets a dust short-circuit fix, this predicate should be checked in the same pass.

manualReview.title: EXIT_ROUNDING_ALLOWANCE sizing analysis: the check needs pps <= 1 + netFloor/10000
manualReview.reason: Parked as evidence feeding DEDUP-002 and DEDUP-003. The code-scanner concluded 'only sub-cent annihilations can revert' and did not file. Tier-3 INV-6 SUPERSEDES that conclusion with a real observation (50 occurrences at HEAD against the real ERC4626 strategy), which is why DEDUP-003 exists. Retained so the two analyses can be compared rather than one silently replacing the other.

manualReview.title: Four open items story-025 carries in its own text and that this run did not independently file
manualReview.reason: PARKED so they are not lost between the story tree and the audit. Two are now partly ADJUDICATED by this run.

items.item: [low] 1 bp proportional allowance leg scales with exit size (Auto-Completed Round 3)
items.status: ADJUDICATED by DEDUP-002 -- filed, and refuted as live by fresh fork measurement.

items.item: [low] floorWithAllowance degenerates to `received > 0` when netFloor <= 2 units + 1 bp; untested (Auto-Completed Round 3)
items.status: CONFIRMED REAL by DEDUP-003 -- INV-6's counterexample is exactly this degenerate case, and it is still untested in the project's own suite.

items.item: [low] autoAnnihilateAvailable does not probe the decimals() > 18 bound (Round 1)
items.status: OPEN. Cosmetic drift carried from round 1; _antimatterScale:1123-1127 fails CLOSED on decimals > 18, so the transaction is safe and only the view is wrong. Adjacent to DEDUP-010.

items.item: [nit] cross-repo UI follow-up story never created after three rounds (phase-2-staging submodule bump, wagmi regen, dead wagmi.config.ts:75 artifact path)
items.status: OPEN. Process item; route with DEDUP-007.

manualReview.title: PROCESS HAZARD: story-025 is machine-approved, not human-reviewed, and its round 2 was rejected outright by its own reviewer
manualReview.reason: PARKED VISIBLY because it is the reason several findings in this run exist and because it bears on how much weight the story's own assurances carry. Verbatim from the story-faithfulness agent: state 'auto-complete'; 'Machine approval, not human-reviewed. Auto-completed on Review Status ISSUES_FOUND, triaged non-blocking by the same automated driver. Round 2 was rejected outright by its own reviewer (blocking [high]); round 3 is the fix-forward. Every round ran --inline-delegation with self-declared Independence: reduced.' DEDUP-002 is the round-2 blocking defect surviving at fee scale; DEDUP-001 falsifies the story's headline claim. Neither would be visible to a reader who trusted the auto-completion.

manualReview.title: Static-analyzer hits on new code that were ADJUDICATED by a higher tier and are retained for traceability
manualReview.reason: PARKED rather than removed because each was actively reasoned about and the reasoning is worth keeping.

items.disposition: FALSE POSITIVE, adjudicated. netWanted = capped/scale then capped - netWanted*scale at :548 is the deliberate sub-unit remainder carry. Conservation proven exact by ECON-005 (MR-17-P02) and by INV-1/INV-2 PASS.

FALSE POSITIVE. _previewExit DOES consume both return values of previewExitFor; the staticcall/decode shape confuses the detector. Note the LINE is nonetheless the most important line in the run -- see DEDUP-007.
Subsumed by DEDUP-010. The real defect at autoAnnihilateAvailable is not a zero-address check; it is that the view disagrees with the transaction.
By design (two staticcalls with try/decode semantics so the view cannot revert). Subsumed by DEDUP-010.

manualReview.title: BULK CARRYOVER: pre-existing static-analysis findings outside this regression run's diff range
manualReview.reason: NOT DROPPED, NOT INDIVIDUALLY TRIAGED. These are the 160 merged Slither/Aderyn/Semgrep results minus the 13 flagged touchesNewCode. They sit on code the diff fa06de5..96d39ed does not touch and are therefore out of a REGRESSION run's scope by construction, not by judgement. They remain in static-analysis-findings.json in full.
manualReview.coverageAssertion: Coverage was verified, not assumed -- all three tools analysed 5 of 5 in-scope files. Slither's filter-paths was anchored to 'stable-staker/lib/' and NOT bare 'lib/' (the known false-clean trap). Raw counts: Slither 79 (40 Medium / 34 Low / 5 Info), Aderyn 97 (8 high / 89 low), Semgrep 157 (ALL severity INFO, entirely style rules: use-custom-error-not-require x88, use-prefix-increment x14, use-short-revert-string x17, ...).
manualReview.action: Re-triage on the next COLD (--full) run, where they are in range.

removedOutright.RULE: Only two categories may be removed outright: (a) exact/near duplicates consolidated in dedup Phases 1-2, traceable via originalIds; (b) pure informational/style noise with no security or spec impact. Every removal is logged here with its reason. No potential-High and no potential-Medium was removed, at any confidence.

items.reason: Scientific-notation suggestion. No security or spec impact. Removed outright per the tool-noise rule.
The literals are the decimals-scaling constants inside _antimatterScale, already analysed and proven fail-closed by CODE-001's clearedHypotheses. No security or spec impact.
netUsed and surplus are declared then unconditionally assigned before use at :590-591. Detector artifact. No security impact.
Slither's 'dangerous comparisons' list for autoAnnihilate contains NO timestamp comparison at all -- it lists received/annihilatable/excess/surplus value comparisons. Misclassification.

items.category: exact duplicate of an existing ledger entry
items.reason: Ignored return of EnumerableSet.remove. This is ledger entry 7b0717792d ('Unused return value of EnumerableSet.add/remove', info, OPEN) recurring on a new line. Removed as a duplicate INSTANCE, not as a finding -- 7b0717792d remains open and now covers autoAnnihilate:569 as well.

Aderyn's boilerplate 'contracts have owners with privileged rights'. Under Law 3 a non-malicious owner is assumed, so the generic form is pure noise. The SPECIFIC, non-obvious footgun on the SAME line was filed as DEDUP-008; the generic template adds nothing to it.

assertions.noHighOrMediumFiltered: CONFIRMED. Zero findings of potential-high or potential-medium severity were removed or parked for low confidence. The two potential-mediums that were REDUCED (ECON-001 -> DEDUP-002 Low) were reduced by fresh mainnet MEASUREMENT that refutes the live case, with the mechanism, the positive control, the Halmos boundary proofs and the named escalation trigger all preserved in full -- not by a quality judgement.
assertions.everyInputAccountedFor: CONFIRMED. 183 candidate inputs -> 13 consolidated findings + 12 parked entries (covering 4 adjudicated + 147 bulk-carried static hits, 5 negative results, 2 pre-existing/dust observations, 4 story-carried items, 1 process hazard) + 9 static hits removed outright with reasons. No input is unaccounted for.
